summary: 4384 partially proves the parent-center route: the Hilbert center c_H is conditionally parent-owned by the existing Hamiltonian/Hilbert worldtube chain, but the topological center is not signed. The remaining obstruction is sharpened to an exact first-moment residual B_top=M_H^{-1} int y(rho_top-rho_H)dV. With equal monopoles, b=||B_top||, so b=0 is equivalent to vector first-moment silence, not full profile equality. 4384 also adds a real-profile import validator that rejects synthetic/smoke/placeholder inputs before the center-lock and quadrature runners can be promoted.
